title: Jesus never called anyone to follow Him halfway.
paragraphs: Jesus never called anyone to follow Him halfway.

He didn’t die for lukewarm faith.
He calls for surrender.
Revelation 3:16 is one of the most uncomfortable verses in the Bible — because it exposes comfortable Christianity.
Are we truly following Him… or just associating with Him?

A lot of people want Jesus…
but only the parts that don’t cost anything.

Church on Sunday.
World the rest of the week.

But Jesus never said:
“Follow me halfway.”
He said deny yourself and follow me.
Do you think lukewarm Christianity is the biggest spiritual problem in the modern church? 🔥
